name: Midas mMEV
oneLiner: mMEV is a Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token wrapping MEV Capital's DeFi lending, liquidity, arbitrage, and liquidation strategies; not a fixed $1 peg.
collateral: MEV Capital-managed DeFi lending, liquidity, arbitrage, carry, and liquidation strategies allocated through Midas liquid-yield token rails.
pegMechanism: Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token with primary mint/redeem through Midas rails; it does not maintain a fixed $1 redemption floor.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas transparency dashboard and issuer disclosures

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (blockchain-based certificate under German law); EEA-restricted, not available to U.S. retail persons

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Midas describes mMEV as tracking delta-neutral DeFi crypto yields under a stable-asset exposure mandate. Its documented same-underlying liquidity provision, statistical arbitrage, and carry trades are explicitly market-neutral, which fits the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype.
